question: In which of the following categories did India NOT win any medal at the Olympic games held in Tokyo in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gymnastics.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Medal winners for India at Olympic Games in Tokyo,2021** were:

 Neeraj Chopra(Gold)

• ​**India has not won any medals in Gymnastics in Tokyo Olympics 2021.**
 
• **India finishes in 48th position** on the medal tally of the Tokyo Olympics, **the best ever in the history of the Olympics for India.​**
